commands_run:
# Run display fusion offline runner across sequences T2, T1, T3 (T2 first)
$env:PYTHONPATH='src'
$env:XVS_DATA_ROOT='<repo>\output'
& .venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts/xvs/display/run_display_g0.py --sequences T2 T1 T3

# Run WP-08 test suite
& .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/xvs/test_display_*.py -v
